description: This file contains API view functions for a course management backend, including user authentication, course, lesson, topic, student, and progress management, as well as dashboard and statistics endpoints.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning server status.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user and logs them in.

methods.name: logout_view
methods.description: Logs out current user and clears session.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Provides dashboard statistics for logged-in teacher.

methods.name: courses
methods.description: Lists or creates courses for the current user.

methods.name: course_detail
methods.description: Retrieve, update, or delete a specific course.

methods.name: topics
methods.description: Lists or creates topics under a course.

methods.name: topic_detail
methods.description: Retrieve, update, or delete a specific topic.

methods.name: lessons
methods.description: Lists or creates lessons under a course.

methods.name: lesson_detail
methods.description: Retrieve, update, or delete a specific lesson.

methods.name: students
methods.description: Lists or creates students for the current user.

methods.name: student_detail
methods.description: Retrieve, update, or delete a specific student.

methods.name: progress_list_create
methods.description: Lists or creates progress entries for a course.
